race.comment: GRAFFITUDE (6) followed up his eye-catching debut effort with a stylish win here in the new colours. Looks to have a touch of class about him and can go on with the job. RULE THE NIGHT (7) was heavily backed when scoring on heavy ground at the Gold Coast after a strong debut effort at Doomben back in May. Has been readied with a neat Doomben trial and looks up to the task. KICKUP ROCKY (2) brings the strongest feature-race reference, having been fourth in the G2 BRC Sires' Produce Stakes at this venue before contesting the G1 J.J. Atkins. His trials suggest he's forward enough. ASHKIRK (1) has won three from four and arrives off two strong late wins, though he will need to raise the bar again here. I'M NOT HERE (11) is another that is progressing well and is in the mix at the light weight.
